⬛ Ethics & Safety

Black box

In simple words

A system whose inner workings are hard to see or explain, even for the people who built it.

A system whose inner workings are hard to see or explain. Even the people who build large neural networks often can't say exactly why a network gave a particular answer.

Example. If an AI turns down someone's loan application, that person should be able to find out why. That's why researchers work on “explainable AI”.

Related words

  • BiasWhen an AI system treats some people or groups unfairly, often because of unbalanced training data.
  • Parameters (weights)The numbers inside a model that change during training and store what it has learned.
  • Neural networkAn AI model made of many simple connected units (neurons), arranged in layers, that learn patterns together.
  • Red teamingTesting an AI by trying hard, on purpose, to make it fail or misbehave, so the problems can be fixed.
